title: Research
text: I am particularly fascinated by face recognition — a deceptively complex cognitive process that touches identity, memory, social perception, and neural architecture. I am eager to explore this domain using neuroimaging methods such as fMRI and EEG.

title: Research
text:
Research Projects
Neuropsychological Assessment in Schizophrenic Patients | 2019 – 2020
University of Vale do Sapucaí, Pouso Alegre, Brazil
This project examined the neuropsychological profiles of patients diagnosed with schizophrenia and evaluated their responses to multidisciplinary treatment. I contributed to patient assessments, data collection, and interpretation of findings. This became the foundation of my undergraduate thesis.
→ Manuscript in preparation for publication.

“For the Right to Exist: Transgender Representation in Media” | 2018 – 2019
University of Vale do Sapucaí, Pouso Alegre, Brazil
Research exploring how transgender and non-binary individuals are represented in media and advertising, and the social implications of these portrayals on public perceptions of gender identity.

Gender Equality Education Program for Children | 2018
Integrated Support Center for Women (CIAMPAR)
Developed and implemented a community-based program aimed at educating children on gender equality.

Women’s Health Public Awareness Initiative | 2020
University of Vale do Sapucaí — Public Health Internship
Digital public health campaign during COVID-19 on women’s health, domestic violence, sexuality, and mental health.
